proof:
Sibling children: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_normal_closure (NCl) and Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_approx_data (AD).
1. By NCl(a): spt(X − Y) ⊆ spt X ∪ spt Y, spt(X − Y) is compact, M(X − Y) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn (X − Y) univ < ∞.
2. By GeometricCurrentOn.ext, fix ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}). It suffices to show lpush(F, X − Y)(ω) = lpush(F, X)(ω) − lpush(F, Y)(ω); by definition of the difference current, the right side is (lpush(F, X) − lpush(F, Y))(ω).
3. Let K := spt X ∪ spt Y, which is compact as a union of two compact sets. AD, applied to Λ, F and K, gives C^∞ maps F_j with ‖fderiv ℝ F_j x‖ ≤ Λ everywhere and F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^N. It also gives test forms η_j and open sets W_j ⊇ K on which η_j = F_j^#ω. For each S ∈ {spt X, spt Y, spt(X − Y)} we have S ⊆ K ⊆ W_j (using step 1 for X − Y). Uniform convergence on ℝ^N gives it on S (TendstoUniformly.tendstoUniformlyOn).
4. Apply (PA) with Λ' := Λ three times, each with the same F_j, ω and η_j: to X, to Y, and to X − Y (normal by step 1). This gives X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω), Y(η_j) → lpush(F, Y)(ω) and (X − Y)(η_j) → lpush(F, X − Y)(ω).
5. Since (X − Y)(η_j) = X(η_j) − Y(η_j) definitionally, also (X − Y)(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω) − lpush(F, Y)(ω) (Tendsto.sub). Uniqueness of limits (tendsto_nhds_unique) gives the claim. □

Lean proof script. It compiled with lake env lean after import GMT.Ch07.Submission, inside namespace GMT.Ch07 with the contract's opens, against the exact frozen types of NCl and AD. It is the tactic body of theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_sub : <lean_statement> := by
  intro lpush hPA N N' k Λ F X Y hF hX1 hX2 hX3 hY1 hY2 hY3
  obtain ⟨hsupp, hZ1, hZ2, hZ3⟩ :=
    Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_normal_closure.1 N k X Y hX1 hX2 hX3 hY1 hY2 hY3
  ext ω
  obtain ⟨Fs, hFs, -, hD, -, hU, hη⟩ :=
    Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_approx_data N N' Λ F (X.support ∪ Y.support) hF (hX1.union hY1)
  obtain ⟨ηs, hηs⟩ := hη k ω
  have hη' : ∀ (S : Set (Euclid N)), S ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support → ∀ j, ∃ W : Set (Euclid N),
      IsOpen W ∧ S ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x =
        ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap
          (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x) := fun S hS j => by
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hKW, h1, -⟩ := hηs j
    exact ⟨W, hW, hS.trans hKW, h1⟩
  have hX := hPA N N' k Λ Λ F Fs X ω ηs hF hX1 hX2 hX3 hFs (fun j x _ => hD j x)
    hU.tendstoUniformlyOn (hη' _ subset_union_left)
  have hY := hPA N N' k Λ Λ F Fs Y ω ηs hF hY1 hY2 hY3 hFs (fun j x _ => hD j x)
    hU.tendstoUniformlyOn (hη' _ subset_union_right)
  have hZ := hPA N N' k Λ Λ F Fs (X - Y) ω ηs hF hZ1 hZ2 hZ3 hFs (fun j x _ => hD j x)
    hU.tendstoUniformlyOn (hη' _ hsupp)
  have hXY : Tendsto (fun j => (X - Y) (ηs j)) atTop
      (𝓝 (lpush N N' k F X ω - lpush N N' k F Y ω)) := hX.sub hY
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hZ hXY
key_steps: NCl(a): X − Y is normal, and spt(X − Y) ⊆ spt X ∪ spt Y.
AD with K = spt X ∪ spt Y gives one approximating sequence that is valid for X, Y and X − Y.
Apply (PA) three times, use (X − Y)(η_j) = X(η_j) − Y(η_j), and conclude by uniqueness of limits.
